name: juggle-mcp
description: Juggle (whyjuggle.com) babysitting and petsitting for Claude — your family account's sits, sitters and messages via natural language

juggle_email.title: Juggle email
juggle_email.description: The email address you sign in to whyjuggle.com with (a family account).

juggle_password.title: Juggle password
juggle_password.description: Your whyjuggle.com password. Google/Facebook-only sign-ins are not supported — set a password on the site first.

mcp_confirm_mode.title: Write confirmation mode
mcp_confirm_mode.description: What a write (post a sit, accept/decline a sitter, cancel, message, favorite, review) does on a client that cannot show a prompt: ask-user (default) needs your approval in chat, auto lets the model confirm after reviewing the preview, refuse blocks writes.

tools.name: juggle_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the Juggle sign-in is configured and accepted, and that an authenticated page read works

tools.name: juggle_get_profile
tools.description: Your family profile: account, city, membership, job stats, saved addresses (ids for posting a sit), pets; kids only on request

tools.name: juggle_get_payments_summary
tools.description: Your city rates, saved cards (brand/last 4), membership, promo credits and recent transactions, in dollars

tools.name: juggle_list_bookings
tools.description: List your sits/jobs: status, service, start time, booked sitter, pending applications; active, past or by status

tools.name: juggle_get_booking
tools.description: One booking in detail: times, kids/pets, notes, applicants and booked sitters, payment total, what you can do

tools.name: juggle_list_sitters
tools.description: Search sitters in your city by availability window, services, keywords or name

tools.name: juggle_list_favorites
tools.description: List the sitters you have marked as favorites

tools.name: juggle_get_sitter
tools.description: A sitter public profile: rating, experience, school, certifications, bio — never private details

tools.name: juggle_get_reviews
tools.description: Reviews other families left for a sitter, with total count and average rating

tools.name: juggle_list_conversations
tools.description: Your message conversations with sitters: last message, time, unread count

tools.name: juggle_get_conversation
tools.description: Read the messages in one conversation, newest page first

tools.name: juggle_list_locations
tools.description: Cities Juggle serves and their published babysitting/petsitting rates (no sign-in needed)

tools.name: juggle_post_job
tools.description: Post a one-time babysitting/petsitting/homeschool-help job (sit), optionally inviting a sitter (confirm-gated)

tools.name: juggle_accept_sitter
tools.description: Accept (book) a sitter who applied to one of your jobs (confirm-gated)

tools.name: juggle_decline_sitter
tools.description: Decline a sitter's application to one of your jobs (confirm-gated)

tools.name: juggle_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking; late cancels only via the one-star-review penalty, never the fee (confirm-gated)

tools.name: juggle_send_message
tools.description: Send a text message in one of your sitter conversations (confirm-gated)

tools.name: juggle_favorite_sitter
tools.description: Add a sitter to your favorites (confirm-gated)

tools.name: juggle_unfavorite_sitter
tools.description: Remove a sitter from your favorites (confirm-gated)

tools.name: juggle_leave_review
tools.description: Leave a 0-5 star (half-star) review of a sitter for a finished booking (confirm-gated)
